notes: The official fiat.com.au 500e page contains only marketing copy ('discover pricing' / 'book a test drive'), not a numeric spec table, so battery/power/range figures are sourced from secondary press (CarSorted aggregator + CarExpert), flagged medium confidence. CarExpert (25 Jul 2025) reported that global production of the standard 500e was halted in 2024 amid slow sales, with a hybrid version in development for production from late 2025; this casts real doubt on ongoing new-vehicle availability of the BEV 500e in Australia by September 2026, so availability is marked 'runout' rather than 'current'. Steep drive-away discounting (down to $38,990 drive-away vs $52,500 before-ORC RRP, an offer that ran only to 30 September 2025) is consistent with stock clearance. Only one current trim, 'La Prima', was confirmed; a separate 'Icon' trim was referenced only in an ANCAP test-vehicle description on CarExpert and could not be confirmed as a distinct orderable Australian trim, so it is not listed as a separate row.
